environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with task role 'DocumentServiceTaskRole'. The IAM policy attached uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition to enforce tenant isolation, and the task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with an ephemeral tmpfs mounted at /var/app/uploads with size limit 512MB and noexec,nosuid mount options. The ECS task runs as UID 1000 (non-root). Additionally, the VPC endpoint policy for the DynamoDB gateway endpoint includes a condition restricting PutItem calls to items where the PK attribute matches the value passed via a custom request header validated by the internal service mesh (Envoy sidecar with ext_authz filter). The container security context sets allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and drops ALL capabilities.

config.network: private subnet, no internet gateway, VPC endpoint for DynamoDB
